department: Doctoral School Engineering - Materials, Mechanical, Environment, Energetics, Processes, Production (ED I-MEP²)

deadline.value: No 2027 contract or admission deadline appears on the fetched pages.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: You must be supervised by an HDR thesis director from the school.
supervisor.quote: Be supervised by an HDR (Habilité à Diriger des Recherches) thesis director from ED I-MEP²

funding.value: Doctoral contracts are awarded after a jury review, with a complementary list for withdrawals.
funding.quote: The results will only be known after the I-MEP² Doctoral School Council meeting | In the event of withdrawal, contracts will be awarded in the order of the complementary list

entry_route.value: You need a Master 2 (with a research internship) or an engineering degree, French or foreign.
entry_route.quote: Hold a French or foreign* degree: Master 2 (including a research internship), Engineer or equivalent

notes: Foreign degrees go through the UGA Doctoral College's CD3 commission, with applications due 15 days before each meeting. Mechanical, civil, electrochemistry and process engineering are specialities of this school.
